class.name: FmodEvent
class.brief_description: An instance of a playing or ready-to-play FMOD Studio event.
class.description: FmodEvent represents one instance of an FMOD Studio event. Create instances via [FmodServer] and start them with [method start]. Call [method release] when the instance is no longer needed so FMOD can clean it up after it stops. [codeblock] var ev = FmodServer.create_event_instance("event:/SFX/Explosion") ev.set_parameter_by_name("Size", 1.0) ev.start() ev.release() [/codeblock]

method.name: event_key_off
method.description: Triggers the key-off point, allowing the event to advance past sustain points and enter its release phase.

method.name: get_2d_attributes
method.description: Returns the current 2D spatial transform of the event.

method.name: get_3d_attributes
method.description: Returns the current 3D spatial transform of the event.

method.name: get_listener_mask
method.description: Returns the listener mask for this event. Each bit corresponds to a listener index.

method.name: get_parameter_by_id
method.description: Returns the current value of the parameter with the given numerical ID.

method.name: get_parameter_by_name
method.description: Returns the current value of the parameter with the given name.

method.name: get_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event is currently paused.

method.name: get_pitch
method.description: Returns the pitch multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal pitch; higher values raise pitch.

method.name: get_playback_state
method.description: Returns the current playback state as one of the [code]FMOD_STUDIO_PLAYBACK_*[/code] constants defined on this class.

method.name: get_programmer_callback_sound_key
method.description: Returns the sound key used for programmer sound callbacks.

method.name: get_reverb_level
method.description: Returns the wet level for the reverb bus at the given index.

method.name: get_timeline_position
method.description: Returns the current playback position on the event's timeline in milliseconds.

method.name: get_volume
method.description: Returns the volume multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal volume.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying FMOD event instance handle is still valid.

method.name: is_virtual
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event is virtual — audible but not consuming a real voice due to voice-stealing.

method.name: release
method.description: Marks the event instance for release. FMOD will destroy the instance once it reaches the stopped state. Always call this when an instance is no longer needed to avoid voice leaks.

method.name: set_2d_attributes
method.description: Sets the 2D spatial position and orientation of the event.

method.name: set_3d_attributes
method.description: Sets the 3D spatial position and orientation of the event.

method.name: set_callback
method.description: Sets a [Callable] to receive FMOD event callbacks. The [param p_callback_mask] is a bitmask of [code]FMOD_STUDIO_EVENT_CALLBACK_*[/code] flags that determines which callback types to receive.

method.name: set_listener_mask
method.description: Sets the listener mask for this event. Each bit corresponds to a listener index. Only listeners whose bit is set will affect this event's spatialization.

method.name: set_node_attributes
method.description: Updates the event's spatial attributes from a node's current transform. Accepts both [Node2D] and [Node3D] nodes.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id
method.description: Sets a parameter by its numerical ID.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id_with_label
method.description: Sets a labeled (enum) parameter by ID using the label string. If [param ignoreseekspeed] is [code]true[/code], the change is applied instantly regardless of the parameter's seek speed.

method.name: set_parameter_by_name
method.description: Sets a parameter by name.

method.name: set_parameter_by_name_with_label
method.description: Sets a labeled (enum) parameter by name using the label string. If [param ignoreseekspeed] is [code]true[/code], the change is applied instantly.

method.name: set_paused
method.description: Pauses or unpauses the event.

method.name: set_pitch
method.description: Sets the pitch multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal pitch.

method.name: set_programmer_callback
method.description: Sets the sound key for programmer sound instruments. Used with FMOD Studio programmer instruments to dynamically supply audio assets at runtime.

method.name: set_reverb_level
method.description: Sets the wet level for the reverb bus at the given index.

method.name: set_timeline_position
method.description: Seeks the event's timeline to the given position in milliseconds.

method.name: set_volume
method.description: Sets the volume multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal volume; [code]0.0[/code] is silent.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts playback of the event instance.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the event. Pass [code]0[/code] ([code]FMOD_STUDIO_STOP_ALLOWFADEOUT[/code]) for a natural fade-out, or [code]1[/code] ([code]FMOD_STUDIO_STOP_IMMEDIATE[/code]) to stop instantly.
